text: そう　インドメタシン　あたえたら　ポケモンの　すばやさが　あがったの

structure.jp: インドメタシン　あたえたら
structure.en: when I gave it the Carbos

structure.jp: ポケモンの　すばやさが　あがったの

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'when I did this', followed by what happened next. あたえたら = 'when I gave it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end shows the speaker is explaining something; women's speech leaves off the だ. あがったの = 'it went up, you see'.
